answer_4.quote: Last, we collect human-annotated intermediate outputs for 536 examples in NLVR2 and for 215 examples in DROP to measure the module-wise faithfulness of models...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators draw the correct bounding boxes for each module in the gold program for visual reasoning and annotate the start and end tokens for spans in textual reasoning.
